Title: Skin of Night and Adaptability Q

Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
As I understand the inferior version of Skin of Night can be played at
any time during combat even if there's no agg damage made yet. But how
about Adaptability's inferior version? May I use it even if my
opponent dind't deal out agg damage in his strike?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No.
